item.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
item.description: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.

item.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
item.description: Syrma SGS Technology reported an 87.2% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 73.2%, reaching a record high of Rs 1,999.5 crore. The company’s exports grew by 91% year-on-year, showcasing strong international demand. Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.

item.title: Zee Entertainment Q2 profit drops 40% to Rs 46 crore as EBITDA margin contracts to 3.2%
item.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 40% decline in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Operating revenue increased by 13%, largely due to growth in subscription revenue supported by the FIFA World Cup 2026. Total expenditure rose by 18% primarily driven by increased programming and promotional costs. ZEE5, the company's streaming platform, showed significant growth by doubling its revenue year-on-year.

item.title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
item.description: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.

item.title: Spandana Sphoorty returns to profit at Rs 18 crore in Q2FY27
item.description: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore year-ago loss. Assets under management grew 31% to Rs 5,364 crore, while improving asset quality reduced gross and net NPAs.

item.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
item.description: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

item.title: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
item.description: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

item.title: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: Revenue up 6%, but late festive season, digital spends hit profit
item.description: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: The company's gross revenue increased 6.4% YoY to Rs 91,716 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 86,169 crore in the year-ago period. The growth came despite the absence of major festive occasions during the quarter, with the festive calendar shifting to the December quarter.

item.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
item.description: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) on Friday reported a 41% year-on-year (YoY) growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 18,165 crore in the corresponding period last year.

item.title: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
item.description: Jio Q2 Results: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 8,389 crore in Q2 FY27, its first results after listing. Revenue grew 11% to Rs 40,475 crore, supported by subscriber additions, growth in digital services and a marginal increase in ARPU.

item.title: NTPC Green Energy Q2 Results: Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 137 crore, revenue rises 53%
item.description: NTPC Green Energy reported a 56.2% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 137.5 crore, driven by 53.2% revenue growth. EBITDA margins improved, while new solar capacity boosted its operational renewable energy portfolio.

item.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9%
item.description: Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27. Net interest income grew 9% to Rs 13,026 crore, while asset quality improved, with the gross NPA ratio declining to 1.78%. Global advances and deposits also recorded double-digit growth.

item.title: Coforge among 6 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 20% in a month
item.description: Six BSE 200 stocks, including Coforge, Indian Hotels and Kotak Mahindra Bank, hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex rallied, with monthly gains reaching 17%.

item.title: 8 midcap stocks with over 100% profit growth in Q2FY27
item.description: Eight NSE midcap stocks recorded over 100% year-on-year profit growth in Q2FY27, led by Max Financial Services, One97 Communications and Poonawalla Fincorp, according to StockEdge data.

item.title: Aditya Birla Capital Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 1,288-cr
item.description: Aditya Birla Capital reported an impressive 38% profit increase for the September quarter of FY27, with profit after tax soaring to Rs 1,288 crore, up from Rs 933.52 crore year-over-year. Operational revenues also climbed significantly, reaching Rs 14,003 crore. Lending assets under management witnessed a robust 32% growth to Rs 2.34 lakh crore, while shares gained 1.75% on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

item.title: Market wrap: Shriram Finance, Nestle India, Trent, InterGlobe top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
item.description: The Nifty 50 rose 0.51% to close at 23,053.10 on Friday, while the Sensex gained 308 points to 74,459.53. Trent and InterGlobe led the gainers, while Shriram Finance and Nestle India topped the Nifty losers. Broader markets remained weak, with midcap and smallcap indices falling up to 2%.

item.title: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
item.description: SEBI has issued a regulatory censure against Axis Capital, concluding proceedings linked to September 2024 restrictions. The regulator noted no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default, while Axis Bank expects no material business impact.

item.title: Asian Paints’ consolidated profit jumps 7.5% YoY in Q2
item.description: Asian Paints reported a 7.5% year-on-year rise in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 1,067.6 crore, while net sales grew 16.9% to Rs 9,953.9 crore. Higher raw material costs weighed on margins, prompting further staggered price hikes. The company also declared a dividend of Rs 5.75 per share.

item.title: Sensex rises 308 points, Nifty above 23,000 even as broader markets crash. Will D-Street bulls extend recovery next week?
item.description: Indian market indices Sensex and Nifty ended the week on a high note, each climbing by up to 0.5%. Even as the broader market suffered losses, standout performers like Trent and IndiGo flourished thanks to positive earnings. The Nifty IT index was a highlight, soaring over 2%, while Nifty Consumer Durables fell nearly 2%.

item.title: FIIs hold $717 billion worth of Indian stocks, but trim exposure across 56% of Nifty 500 companies. Where are they investing?
item.description: FIIs held $717 billion worth of Nifty 500 stocks in September 2026, with private banks accounting for the largest share of their investments. While foreign investors increased exposure to sectors such as healthcare, technology and automobiles, they trimmed holdings in 56% of Nifty 500 companies over the past year.

item.title: Sun Pharma Q2 Results: Profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 1,989 crore on exceptional charges
item.description: Sun Pharma Q2 Results: Revenue from operations rose 12% YoY to Rs 16,199 crore from Rs 14,478 crore in Q2 of last financial year, supported by strong growth in its domestic formulations business and emerging markets.

item.title: Varun Beverages shares fall over 4% as Q3 margin pressure weighs despite a 33% YoY revenue growth
item.description: Varun Beverages reported strong Q3 CY2026 revenue, profit and volume growth, but its shares fell as higher packaging costs weighed on margins. EBITDA margin declined 140 basis points year-on-year, while the company announced an interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per share.

item.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results 2026 Live: RIL Q2 profit jumps 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore; co posts highest-ever quarterly revenue; Jio ARPU rises to Rs 218.8
Coal India shares fall 3% after Q2 results; Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, others cut target price
item.description: Coal India shares fell 3% despite a 57% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,547 crore. Jefferies and JM Financial cut their target prices to Rs 460 and Rs 438, respectively, while Motilal Oswal retained its Buy rating with a Rs 450 target, citing a potential volume recovery.

item.title: Explained: Why AI giants Google, Amazon, Intel shares crashed up to 23% in a single day
item.description: Shares of Alphabet, Amazon and Intel plunged on Thursday as investors fretted over rising AI spending, weakening cash flows and a subdued outlook. Alphabet shares fell over 13% after its Q3 results missed Wall Street estimates, with slowing search advertising growth and higher AI investments weighing on sentiment.

item.title: Equitas SFB shares tumble 27% in 2 days on CEO exit. More pain ahead?
item.description: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares plunged 27% in two sessions after CEO and founder PN Vasudevan announced his resignation over a perceived conflict involving his daughter’s NBFC.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty turn lower; broader markets crash as oil tops $116/barrel. What lies ahead?
item.description: Indian equities turned lower as crude oil prices crossed $116 per barrel, raising concerns about inflation and economic growth. While the Sensex and Nifty posted modest declines, midcap and smallcap indices fell more sharply amid weak market breadth.

item.title: Q2 earnings upgrades hold above 50%, says Jefferies. Is the profit cycle turning?
item.description: India’s Q2 FY27 earnings show signs of resilience, with Jefferies reporting that 50% of the 105 companies it tracks received FY27 earnings estimate upgrades, while 41% saw downgrades and 9% remained unchanged. The share of companies beating expectations rose to 56% from 52% in the previous quarter, though the recovery remains uneven across sectors.

item.title: ITC, RIL, HDFC Bank among top laggards as Nifty falls over 12% in 2026: Time to buy beaten-down stocks or wait for a recovery?
item.description: In 2026, the Nifty 50 index faced significant drops, with 34 out of 50 stocks plummeting by as much as 34%. Analysts believe that the sell-off is driven by foreign institutional investor exits and a conservative outlook on earnings. This decline presents potential opportunities for long-term investors as valuations dip below historical norms.

item.title: Q2 results impact: 2 Vedanta stocks rally up to 14% after Sept quarter earnings. How have they performed since demerger?
item.description: Shares of Vedanta Power and Vedanta Oil and Gas rallied up to 14% after both demerged companies reported a sharp year-on-year improvement in Q2 FY27 earnings. Vedanta Power returned to profit, while Vedanta Oil and Gas reported higher revenue and EBITDA.

item.title: Laurus Labs shares climb 4% after Q2 profit zooms 126% YoY
item.description: Laurus Labs shares rose 3.79% to Rs 2,329 after the pharmaceutical company reported strong Q2FY27 results. Revenue increased 33% year-on-year to Rs 2,206 crore, while net profit more than doubled to Rs 441 crore. Growth was supported by sustained momentum in its CDMO business and Affordable Medicines division, alongside improving margins and continued investments in manufacturing capabilities.

item.title: Jio Platforms share price up 28% from IPO price. Here’s what these 4 brokerages are saying
item.description: Jio Platforms shares extended their post-listing rally, rising over 28% in three sessions. Nomura, Motilal Oswal, Dolat Capital and Elara Capital remain positive, citing tariff hikes, 5G monetisation, broadband expansion and digital services growth.

item.title: Ashish Kacholia Q2 portfolio: Ace investor adds 3 new stocks, increases stake in 2 companies. Own any?
item.description: In the second quarter of 2027, Ashish Kacholia has made notable changes to his investment portfolio. He has increased his stakes in both Indo SMC and Stove Kraft, which have demonstrated impressive growth this year. Additionally, Kacholia has invested in newly-listed firms like ESDS Software Solutions and Ardee Industries, as well as Credent Connect N Care, reflecting his adaptive strategy amidst evolving market trends.

item.title: Reliance Industries Q2 results today: Can the old economy rescue the new Reliance?
item.description: Reliance Industries is poised to reveal its Q2 earnings, with anticipation surrounding a notable profit revival in its oil-to-chemicals division. Analysts forecast a rise in consolidated EBITDA, supported by enhanced refining margins and solid petrochemical performance. Jio Platforms should offer consistent contributions, though Reliance Retail may face pressures with shrinking margins. Investors will keep a watchful eye on insights regarding future expansion in new energy ventures.

item.title: IndiGo shares rise 2% after Q2 losses narrow. What are Jefferies and other brokerages saying?
item.description: IndiGo shares gained 2% after the airline reported a narrower year-on-year Q2 loss of Rs 1,879 crore, although profitability remained under pressure from elevated fuel costs and rupee depreciation. Jefferies retained its Buy rating but cut its target price to Rs 5,650, while Nuvama maintained its Buy call with a revised target of Rs 5,435.

item.title: Nifty rout hides a striking bull run: Smallcap universe gives 60 multibaggers since last Diwali
item.description: The stock market in India has encountered a rough patch, evidenced by the Nifty's decline of over 11% since last Diwali. However, smallcap stocks have emerged as stars, with 60 multibagger stocks tripling investors' money; Sterlite Technologies notably climbed 649.7%. Investors are cautioned to consider valuations seriously while pinpointing companies with significant growth potential for smarter investment decisions.

item.title: Diwali blues: 83 largecap stocks plunge up to 60% since Samvat 2082. Can bluechips light up D-Street in the new year?
item.description: Indian equities enter Samvat 2083 after a volatile year and a sharp market correction. While lower valuations have improved the risk-reward profile of several stocks, persistent FII outflows, elevated crude oil prices and global uncertainties remain key concerns. Strong domestic fundamentals and earnings growth could support markets, but returns will increasingly depend on stock selection, valuations and earnings delivery.

item.title: Reliance Industries shares down 26% in 2026: Here’s how to trade RIL stocks on results day
item.description: Reliance Industries has faced a notable drop in its shares by 26% throughout 2026. Investors and analysts are eagerly awaiting the upcoming results announcement. Past quarterly results have evoked varied responses, leading to fluctuations in stock value. Important technical thresholds to keep an eye on include Rs 1,130 acting as a support level and Rs 1,230 identified as a breakout benchmark.

item.title: Trent shares soar 7% after Q2 results. Here’s why Elara Capital, Nuvama remain bullish on the Tata stock
item.description: Trent shares rallied after the retailer reported 25% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27 profit and a 21.9% rise in revenue. Elara Capital upgraded the stock to Buy, while Nuvama maintained its positive stance and Systematix retained Hold.

item.title: Core4 Engineers SME shares to list today: Check IPO subscription status and other key details
item.description: Core4 Engineers will make its debut on the BSE SME platform on October 30 after its Rs 54.82 crore IPO was subscribed 5.44 times. The NII category led demand with 12.26 times subscription, followed by QIBs at 5.06 times and individual investors at 2.72 times. The IPO was entirely a fresh issue of 58.94 lakh shares.

item.title: Suzlon Energy shares crash 10% as Nuvama, others slash target prices after Q2 margins disappoint. What lies ahead?
item.description: After Suzlon Energy's quarterly results for September were unveiled, its shares fell nearly 10%. The company faced a staggering 69% decline in net profit, despite enjoying a 26% increase in revenue from wind turbine deliveries. Nuvama raised flags regarding lower-than-expected EBITDA margins, likely influencing the stock's dip. Nonetheless, Centrum Broking maintains a 'Buy' rating, indicating potential for recovery.

item.title: Asian Paints shares see target price cuts by Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, other brokerages after Q2 results. Buy, sell or hold?
item.description: Asian Paints has reported a year-on-year profit growth of 7% for the second quarter of FY 2027. Revenue surged by around 17%, although expenses climbed by 19%, underscoring the challenges posed by inflation. Despite brokerages adjusting their target prices, the company declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 per share and hinted at upcoming price hikes.

item.title: Hero MotoCorp among 4 stocks that closed below VWAP
item.description: VWAP represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, weighted by trading volume.

item.title: HDFC Life Share Price Highlights: HDFC Life Stock Price History
JSW Energy among 6 Nifty500 stocks showing RSI trending up
item.description: Six Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5.5% on October 29 featured in StockEdge’s RSI Trending Up scan, indicating strengthening price momentum as their Relative Strength Index (RSI) values crossed above 50 from below.

item.title: Tata Capital among 4 Nifty500 stocks closing above VWAP
item.description: Four Nifty500 stocks closed more than 1.5% above their respective volume-weighted average prices (VWAPs) on October 29, according to StockEdge’s technical scan, indicating that they ended the session above their average traded prices.

item.title: Milky Mist shares rally 5% after Q2 PAT soars 175%; firm says festive season will create favourable demand ahead
item.description: Milky Mist Dairy Food reported a 175% increase in net profit for the second quarter of FY27. The company's revenue reached Rs 1,089.40 crore, marking a 42% rise compared to last year. This growth was driven by increased sales volumes and strong demand for value-added dairy products. Additionally, the launch of new protein-focused product lines contributed to positive financial results.

item.title: ONGC Share Price Highlights: ONGC Stock Price History
Adani Enterprises among 4 Nifty500 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
item.description: Four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 4% on October 29 featured in StockEdge’s White Marubozu bullish scan, signalling strong upward price momentum during the trading session.
